name: Master Cartographer Lin
bio: Commissions your maps in Atlas of Ink. Owns a scrying quill and very strong opinions about coastlines.

portrait.subject: a cute fussy old fantasy cartographer with a long grey ponytail, half-moon spectacles, an ink-stained robe and a glowing scrying quill
portrait.background: parchment map table with an ink island and compass rose

request: Lin, Royal Cartographer, Atlas of Ink. I have a commission. And a friendship offer. 🗺️
hello: Hold the scry key. Stand still. Breathe.
about: I'm Lin. I chart the kingdom with my scrying quill. The island is hidden; we reveal it a disc at a time.
how: Hold the scry key to focus and release to cast: standing still builds focus, moving bleeds it. Chart the hidden island disc by disc.
tips: Stand still to build focus. Patience makes clean maps.
chat: Someone drew a sea monster on my map. Fine. It's accurate.
My quill spilled. There's a new lake now.
A cove I mapped today looked like a cat.
North is up. Always. I'm very firm on this.
nudge: A new commission has arrived. Shall we chart?
idle: {ago} without a map. The island's getting misty.

questions.q: Should we draw sea monsters on the edges?
a: Hmm. That's the problem, isn't it?

update: The atlas grows: Atlas of Ink is now v{version}.
bye: Lin returns to the drafting table.
